import psycopg2
from flask import request
from psycopg2.sql import SQL, Identifier

def create(con, schema):
    name = request.json["db_name"]
    pwd = request.json["db_pwd"]
    with con.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(SQL("CREATE USER {} WITH PASSWORD %s;").format(
            Identifier(name),
        ), (pwd,))
        cur.execute(SQL("CREATE DATABASE {} OWNER {};").format(
            Identifier(schema), Identifier(name),
        ))

from pathlib import Path
import shutil

from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()
BASE = Path("/srv/apps")

def sanitize_path(name: str) -> str:
    return name if name not in ("", ".", "..") and "/" not in name else ""

@app.post("/uninstall/{app_name}")
async def uninstall_app(app_name: str):
    app_name = sanitize_path(app_name)
    app_path = BASE / app_name
    if app_path.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(app_path)
    return {"ok": True}

notes.probe:
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

LOG_NAME = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128}$")

def run_tool(cli: str, workdir: str, log_file_name: str) -> None:
    if not LOG_NAME.fullmatch(log_file_name):
        raise ValueError("invalid log name")
    batch = Path(workdir) / f"batch_{log_file_name}.do"
    batch.write_text(f'log using "{log_file_name}.log"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run([cli, "/e", "do", batch.as_posix()], shell=True, check=True)
